narration: Two men were in the water eleven and a half miles off Haleiwa, Hawaii, next to their capsized ten-foot catamaran.
A Coast Guard Hercules plane and a Dolphin helicopter crew from Air Station Barbers Point found them out there.
The helicopter lowered a rescue basket on a steel cable, and the flight mechanic in the open door brought each man up one at a time.
The basket is for survivors who can climb in on their own. Injured people go up strapped into a stretcher instead.
outcome: Both men were hoisted safely and brought ashore to the air station in Kapolei.
title: Their catamaran flipped 11 miles off Hawaii
description:
Two men ended up in the water after their 10-foot catamaran capsized about 11.5 miles off Haleiwa, Hawaii, on July 14, 2026. A Coast Guard HC-130 Hercules crew and an MH-65 Dolphin crew from Air Station Barbers Point found them, hoisted them and brought them ashore.
